Try again.", easyClose = TRUE, footer = NULL )) } }) # Read and visualize User-provided input # #user_data <- reactive({ # if (reset_flag()) return(NULL) # Se il flag è attivo, non caricare dati # req(input$raw_data) # sep <- switch(input$sep, "comma" = ",", "semi-colon" = ";", "tab" = "\t", "space" = " ") # read.table(input$raw_data$datapath, sep = sep, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) #}) #activate shinyhelpers (not supported in shinylive) #observe_helpers() #### Check running platform #### # check if running into the browser or in native shiny server is_shinylive <- function() { # 3) check if R platform contains 'wasm' (es. "wasm32-unknown-emscripten") plat <- if (!is.null(R.version$platform)) R.version$platform else "" e3 <- grepl("wasm", plat, ignore.case = TRUE) # return TRUE if the app is running in a shinylive wasm environment #any(c(e1, e2, e3)) return(e3) } # Set console message to declare app running status if (is_shinylive()) { message("Running under Shinylive / webR ") } else { message("Running in native R / Shiny server") } #### Enable "Start" button action #### # Send to first app page when "Start" is toggled observeEvent(list(input$go_to_app, input$load_toy_data_btn), { updateNavbarPage(session, "MycorrhizeR", selected = "load_data") }, ignoreInit = T) #### Store default values #### # inizialize a reactiveVal to store default inputs default_inputs <- reactiveVal() # run an observer at startup to set values as default ones observe({ # Execute once at startup isolate({ default_inputs(reactiveValuesToList(input)) }) }) #### Import Data #### # load data and react upon separator change # observeEvent(list(input$raw_data, input$sep), { # req(input$raw_data) # # set column separator upon user's input # sep <- switch(input$sep, "comma" = ",", "semi-colon" = ";", "tab" = "\t", "space" = " ") # # import user's data into a df # df <- read.table(input$raw_data$datapath, sep = sep, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) # # if (!validateInput(toupper(df$Scoring))) { # #Show messages # showModal(modalDialog( # title = span("❌ Error", style = "color:#c0392b;"), # paste("Unattended value in row", ", column"), # easyClose = TRUE, # footer = modalButton("Close") # )) # #return() # } else { # # # # update user_data() reactiveValue with loaded file # user_data(df) # # Disable reset flag when the new file has been loaded # reset_flag(FALSE) # } # }) observeEvent(list(input$raw_data, input$sep), { req(input$raw_data) req(input$sep) sep <- switch(input$sep, "comma" = ",", "semi-colon" = ";", "tab" = "\t", "space" = " ", ",") # safe import df <- tryCatch( read.table(input$raw_data$datapath, sep = sep, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = "", quote = "\""), error = function(e) e ) if (inherits(df, "error")) { showModal(modalDialog( title = span("❌ Error reading file", style = "color:#c0392b;"), paste0("Could not read uploaded file: ", df$message), easyClose = TRUE, footer = modalButton("Close") )) return() } # Define required columns once required_cols <- c("Samples", "slide", "Replicates", "Scoring", "condition") # Check if loaded data.frame has all required columns missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df)) if (length(missing_cols) > 0) { showModal(modalDialog( title = span("❌ Missing required column(s)", style = "color:#c0392b;"), HTML(paste0( "The uploaded file is missing the following column(s):
", "", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "

", "Please upload a file that includes all required columns: ", paste(required_cols, collapse = ", "), "." )), easyClose = TRUE, footer = modalButton("Close") )) return() } # # Check if loaded data.frame has right columns # if (!all(c("Samples", "slide", "Replicates", "Scoring", "condition") %in% colnames(df))) { # showNotification("Failed to load file: the required columns were not found", type = "error") # return() # } # Validate all Scoring value scoring_vec <- toupper(as.character(df$Scoring)) invalid_idx <- which(!vapply(scoring_vec, function(x) { if (is.na(x) || x == "") return(FALSE) isTRUE(validateInput(x)) }, logical(1))) if (length(invalid_idx) > 0) { # Select rows and values invalid_values <- scoring_vec[invalid_idx] invalid_table <- data.frame( Row = invalid_idx, Invalid_Value = invalid_values ) # Parse message msg <- paste0( "⚠️ Found ", length(invalid_idx), " invalid value(s) in column 'Scoring'.

", "First 10 shown below:" ) # Show modal with a table of invalid values (DT::renderDataTable) showModal(modalDialog( title = span("❌ Invalid values detected", style = "color:#c0392b;"), HTML(msg), renderTable( head(invalid_table, 10), bordered = TRUE, striped = TRUE, spacing = 's' ), easyClose = TRUE, footer = modalButton("Close"), size = "l" )) return() } # If Scorings are validated update reactive and reset flag user_data(df) reset_flag(FALSE) }) # old observer for filed separator changes (integrated in the previous observed) # Add an observeEvent for field separator # observeEvent(input$sep, { # # run if there is loaded file # if (!is.null(input$raw_data)) { # sep <- switch(input$sep, "comma" = ",", "semi-colon" = ";", "tab" = "\t", "space" = " ") # df <- read.table(input$raw_data$datapath, sep = sep, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) # user_data(df) # Aggiorna user_data con il nuovo separatore # } # }, ignoreInit = TRUE) # ignoreInit = TRUE evita che si attivi al caricamento iniziale # ##### Load toy dataset at user's request ##### observeEvent(list(input$load_toy_data, input$load_toy_data_btn), { reset_flag(TRUE) toy_data <- read.delim("data/Trouvelot.tsv") #toy_data <- read.delim("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mchiapello/Ramf/refs/heads/master/inst/extdata/trouvelot.csv", sep=",") user_data(toy_data) reset_flag(FALSE) }, ignoreInit = T) #### define reactiveValues #### # create reactiveValue to store input and settings user_data <- reactiveVal(NULL) reset_flag <- reactiveVal(FALSE) user_val <- reactiveVal(NULL) # Create data_store() reactive value data_store <- reactiveVal(data.frame( Samples = character(), slide = character(), Replicates = character(), Scoring = character(), condition = character(), row = integer(), column = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE )) # set selected variables upon user's input into user_val() reactive observe( if (!is.null(input$var_select)) { columns_raw = debounceInput(input$var_select, 500) columns <- c("Samples", "Replicates", "slide", "fragments", columns_raw) user_val(columns) } else { user_val(c("Samples", "Replicates", "slide", "fragments", "F", "M", "a", "A")) } #else {updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "var_select", selected = c("F", "M", "a", "A")) } ) # Create data_analysis() reactive value to store results data_analysis <- reactiveVal() #output$user_table <- DT::renderDataTable({ output$user_table <- DT::renderDT({ #output$user_table <- renderTable({ req(user_data()) datatable(user_data()) #DT::datatable(user_data()) }) #### Slide data management #### ##### Render slide grid using table layout ##### # output$grid <- renderUI({ # tagList( # div( # style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;", # actionButton("add", "add slide", class = "btn-primary"), # actionButton("newSlide", "new slide", class = "btn btn-success"), # actionButton("remove_grid", "remove slide", class = "btn btn-danger") # ), # div( # style = "display: table; width: 400px; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 1px;", # lapply(1:input$rows, function(row) { # div( # style = "display: table-row;", # lapply(1:input$columns, function(col) { # div( # style = "display: table-cell; width: 90px; height: 45", # textInput( # inputId = paste0("cell_", row, "_", col), # label = NULL, # value = getCurrentValue( # input$Samples, # input$slide, # input$Replicates, # input$condition, # row, # col # ) # ) %>% tagAppendAttributes(style = "width: 90px !important;") # Forza la larghezza dell'input # ) # }) # ) # }) # )) # }) # output$grid <- renderUI({ # tagList( # # Pulsanti sopra la griglia # div( # style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;", # actionButton("add", "add slide", class = "btn-primary"), # actionButton("newSlide", "new slide", class = "btn btn-success"), # actionButton("remove_grid", "remove slide", class = "btn btn-danger") # ), # # # Grid # div( # style = "display: table;", # lapply(1:input$rows, function(row) { # div( # style = "display: table-row;", # lapply(1:input$columns, function(col) { # div( # style = "display: table-cell; padding: 0; margin: 0;", # textInput( # inputId = paste0("cell_", row, "_", col), # label = NULL, # value = getCurrentValue( # input$Samples, # input$slide, # input$Replicates, # input$condition, # row, # col # ) # ) %>% tagAppendAttributes( # style = paste( # "width: 90px !important;", # "height: 30px !important;", # "margin: 4px;", # spazio verticale e orizzontale tra celle # "padding: 0 !important;", # "border: none !important;", # "border-radius: 0 !important;", # "box-sizing: border-box;", # "background-color: #fff;", # "line-height: 30px;", # "text-align: center;" # ) # ) # ) # }) # ) # }) # ) # ) # }) output$grid <- renderUI({ tagList( # Pulsanti sopra la griglia div( style = "display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;", actionButton("add", "add slide", class = "btn-primary"), actionButton("newSlide", "new slide", class = "btn btn-success"), actionButton("remove_grid", "remove slide", class = "btn btn-danger") ), # Grid div( style = "display: table;", lapply(1:input$rows, function(row) { div( style = "display: table-row;", lapply(1:input$columns, function(col) { div( style = "display: table-cell; padding: 0; margin: 0;", textInput( inputId = paste0("cell_", row, "_", col), label = NULL, value = getCurrentValue( input$Samples, input$slide, input$Replicates, input$condition, row, col ) ) %>% tagAppendAttributes( style = paste( "width: 90px !important;", "height: 30px !important;", "margin: 4px;", # spazio verticale e orizzontale tra celle "padding: 0 !important;", "border: none !important;", "border-radius: 0 !important;", "box-sizing: border-box;", "background-color: #fff;", "line-height: 30px;", #"pointer-events: none;", "text-align: center;" ) ) %>% { #req(TRUE) if (!isTruthy(input$Samples) || !isTruthy(input$Replicates) || !isTruthy(input$condition) || !isTruthy(input$slide)) { tagAppendAttributes(., style = paste("pointer-events: none;"), class="highlight-error-grid") } else { . } } ) }) ) }) ) ) }) ##### Validate user's score input # Old <- function(Scoring) { # if (Scoring == "" || Scoring == "0") return(TRUE) # grepl("^[0-5]A[0-3](V[0-3])?(H\\d+)?$", Scoring) # } validateInput <- function(Scoring) { if (Scoring == "" || Scoring == "0") return(TRUE) # If first score number is zero: only A0, V0 e H0 allowed if (substr(Scoring, 1, 1) == "0") { return(grepl("^0A0(V0)?(H0)?$", Scoring)) } # otherwise A[0-3] and V[0-3] are allowed grepl("^[0-5]A[0-3](V[0-3])?(H\\d+)?$", Scoring) } # Obtain current value of cell when selecting slide in table getCurrentValue <- function(Samples, slide, Replicates, condition, row, col) { if (is.null(Samples) || is.null(slide)) return("") df <- data_store() val <- df[df$Samples == Samples & df$slide == slide & df$Replicates == as.character(Replicates) & df$condition == condition & df$row == row & df$column == col, "Scoring"] if (length(val) == 0) return("") return(val) } # obtain values for a given slide getGridData <- function() { req(input$Samples, input$slide, input$Replicates, input$condition) key <- paste(input$Samples, input$slide, input$Replicates, input$condition, sep = "_") all_data <- grid_storage() if (!is.null(all_data[[key]])) { return(all_data[[key]]) # return saved data for the given key } else { return(list()) # no data saved for this combination } } # # Manage user data input # observeEvent(input$add, { # req(input$Samples, input$slide, input$Replicates, input$condition) # # new_rows <- list() # # for (row in 1:input$rows) { # for (col in 1:input$columns) { # Scoring <- input[[paste0("cell_", row, "_", col)]] # # # if (!validateInput(toupper(Scoring))) { # # # # #Show messages # # showNotification( # # paste("Unattended value in row", row, ", column", col), # # type = "error", closeButton = T, duration = 10 # # ) # # # showModal(modalDialog( # # # title = span("❌ Error", style = "color:#c0392b;"), # # # paste("Unattended value in row", row, ", column", col), # # # easyClose = TRUE, # # # footer = modalButton("Close") # # #)) # # return() # # } # # if (Scoring != "") { # new_rows[[length(new_rows) + 1]] <- list( # Samples = input$Samples, # slide = input$slide, # Replicates = as.character(input$Replicates), # Scoring = toupper(Scoring), # condition = input$condition, # row = row, # column = col # ) # } # } # } # # if (length(new_rows) > 0) { # new_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(new_rows, as.data.frame)) # # current_data <- data_store() # current_data <- current_data[!( # current_data$Samples == input$Samples & # current_data$slide == input$slide & # current_data$Replicates == as.character(input$Replicates) & # current_data$condition == input$condition # ), ] # # # add data to data_store() reactiveValue # data_store(rbind(current_data, new_data)) # reset_flag(FALSE) # showNotification("Slide succesfully added", type = "message") # } # }) # Manage user data input observeEvent(input$add, { req(input$Samples, input$slide, input$Replicates, input$condition) invalid_found <- FALSE # flag per bloccare se ci sono errori new_rows <- list() # Check all cells entries for (row in 1:input$rows) { for (col in 1:input$columns) { cell_id <- paste0("cell_", row, "_", col) Scoring <- input[[cell_id]] if (Scoring != "") { if (!validateInput(toupper(Scoring))) { shinyjs::addClass(selector = paste0("#", cell_id), class = "highlight-error") # Show modal with error showModal(modalDialog( title = span("⚠️ Error", style = "color:#c0392b;"), HTML("Invalid values detected!"), easyClose = TRUE, footer = modalButton("Close"), size = "s" )) #showNotification( # paste("Unattended value in row", row, ", column", col), # type = "error", closeButton = TRUE, duration = 10 #) invalid_found <- TRUE } else { shinyjs::removeClass(selector = paste0("#", cell_id), class = "highlight-error") new_rows[[length(new_rows) + 1]] <- list( Samples = input$Samples, slide = input$slide, Replicates = as.character(input$Replicates), Scoring = toupper(Scoring), condition = input$condition, row = row, column = col ) } } } } # If invalid value are found, blocking message if (invalid_found) { showNotification( "⚠️ One or more invalid entries detected. Please correct them before adding.", type = "error", closeButton = TRUE, duration = 8 ) return() } # Save data if all cells are valid if (length(new_rows) > 0) { new_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(new_rows, as.data.frame)) current_data <- data_store() current_data <- current_data[!( current_data$Samples == input$Samples & current_data$slide == input$slide & current_data$Replicates == as.character(input$Replicates) & current_data$condition == input$condition ), ] data_store(rbind(current_data, new_data) %>% arrange(Samples, Replicates, slide, condition, row, column)) reset_flag(FALSE) showNotification("Slide successfully added", type = "message") } }) # observe added values and validate inputs observe({ for (row in 1:input$rows) { for (col in 1:input$columns) { local({ r <- row c <- col cell_id <- paste0("cell_", r, "_", c) observeEvent(input[[cell_id]], { value <- debounceInput(input[[cell_id]], 100) if (!validateInput(toupper(value))) { shinyjs::addClass(selector = paste0("#", cell_id), class = "highlight-error") showNotification( paste("Unattended value in row", r, ", column", c), type = "error", closeButton = T, duration = 10 ) #shinyjs::disable("add") } else { shinyjs::removeClass(selector = paste0("#", cell_id), class = "highlight-error") #shinyjs::enable("add") } }, ignoreInit = TRUE) }) } } }) # set condition field with default value # Render slide table output$slide_table <- renderDT({ datatable(data_store(), options = list( pageLength = -1, fixedHeader = list( header = TRUE, headerOffset = 0, columnDefs = list(list(type = 'string', targets = 3)) ), scrollY = "400px", # scroo height scrollCollapse = TRUE, order = list(list(0, 'asc'), list(1, 'asc')) ), selection = "single", editable = F) }, server = FALSE) # Update table if data are modified interactively into the cell grid observeEvent(input$slide_table_cell_edit, { info <- input$slide_table_cell_edit updated_data <- data_store() updated_data[info$row, info$col] <- info$Scoring data_store(updated_data) }) # Select grid from Table observeEvent(input$slide_table_rows_selected, { req(input$slide_table_rows_selected) # Obtain selected row selected_row <- input$slide_table_rows_selected selected_data <- data_store()[selected_row, ] # Update metadata with slide values from the selected row updateTextInput(session, "Samples", value = selected_data$Samples) updateTextInput(session, "slide", value = selected_data$slide) updateTextInput(session, "Replicates", value = selected_data$Replicates) updateTextInput(session, "condition", value = selected_data$condition) # update selectInput value<-selected_data %>% unite("id", Samples, Replicates, sep=" ", remove = F) updateSelectInput( session, "exp_condition", selected = value ) }) # Select grid from GroupRadioButtons / selectInput observeEvent(c(input$exp_condition), { req(input$exp_condition) # extract categories category<-data_store() %>% #distinct(Samples, Replicates, condition, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% unite("id", Samples, Replicates, sep=" ", remove = F) %>% filter(id==input$exp_condition) %>% arrange(slide) %>% slice(1) # select row # Update metadata with slide values from the selected row updateTextInput(session, "Samples", value = category$Samples) updateTextInput(session, "slide", value = category$slide) updateTextInput(session, "Replicates", value = category$Replicates) updateTextInput(session, "condition", value = category$condition) # point to the right row in table index <- which( data_store()$Samples == category$Samples & data_store()$Replicates == category$Replicates & data_store()$condition == category$condition & data_store()$slide == category$slide) proxy_slide <- dataTableProxy("slide_table", session = session) selectRows(proxy_slide, index[1], ignore.selectable=T) #print(session$ns("slide")) }) # debug #output$debug_selection <- renderPrint({ # paste("Riga selezionata in DT:", input$slide_table_rows_selected) #}) # Update table if loaded through "Load file sheet" observeEvent(user_data(), { df <- user_data() # Add row and columns variable if missing (fill with NA) if (!"row" %in% colnames(df)) df$row <- NA if (!"column" %in% colnames(df)) df$column <- NA # Update data_store with loaded data data_store(df) }) # Reset the flag after uploading a new file observeEvent(input$raw_data, { reset_flag(FALSE) # set reset_flag to False when loading a new file }) # Delete visualized grid observeEvent(input$remove_grid, { req(input$Samples, input$slide, input$Replicates, input$condition) # Get all current data stored current_data <- data_store() # Remove data filtering by Samples, slide and condition filtered_data <- current_data[!( current_data$Samples == input$Samples & current_data$slide == input$slide & current_data$Replicates == as.character(input$Replicates) & current_data$condition == input$condition ), ] # Update data_store() data_store(filtered_data) showNotification("Slide succesfully removed!", type = "message") }) # Delete ALL data and plot settings # delete data also in "Upload file sheet reset_flag <- reactiveVal(FALSE) # Delete all data from the app observeEvent(input$delete, { # Show a modal dialog to ask confirm # showModal(modalDialog( # title = "Warning", # "All data and settings will be deleted, the operation can't be undone. Are you sure to continue? # Note that plotting settings can be exported in JSON format and reloaded in another session through the Data Analysis page (Plot pane).", # #modalButton("Cancel"), # actionButton("confirmDelete", "Delete", class = "btn-primary") # )) showModal(modalDialog( title = tags$span( icon("exclamation-triangle", style = "color: #ff9800;"), " Confirm Deletion", style = "font-weight: 600;" ), tags$div( tags$p( class = "text-danger", style = "font-size: 1.05em; margin-bottom: 10px;", icon("trash-alt"), " All data and settings will be ", tags$strong("permanently deleted"), " and cannot be recovered. Are you sure to continue?" ), tags$div( class = "alert alert-info", style = "margin-top: 15px; margin-bottom: 0;", icon("lightbulb"), tags$strong(" Note: "), "Current session can be recovered by exporting data and settings and by reloading files into the app. " ) ), footer = tagList( modalButton("Cancel"), actionButton("confirmDelete", "Delete All", class = "btn btn-danger") ), easyClose = FALSE )) }) # delete data upon user's confirm observeEvent(input$confirmDelete, { removeModal() # Close modal dialog window data_store(data.frame( Samples = character(), slide = character(), Replicates = character(), Scoring = character(), condition = character(), row = integer(), column = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE )) data_analysis(NULL) reset_flag(TRUE) user_data(NULL) ramf_arb(NULL) # Reset the file uploader # TBD # Disable buttons shinyjs::disable("getPNG") shinyjs::disable("getTIFF") shinyjs::disable("settings") shinyjs::disable("getRData") shinyjs::disable("downloadData") showNotification("Data successfully deleted", type = "message") # Reset user's input to default values defaults <- default_inputs() # Reset all slides metadata fields updateTextInput(session, "Samples", value = "") updateTextInput(session, "slide", value = "") updateTextInput(session, "Replicates", value = "") updateTextInput(session, "condition", value = "") # Exclude visualized navbar page from the reset exclude_vars <- c("MycorrhizeR") vars_to_reset <- setdiff(names(defaults), exclude_vars) for (variable in names(vars_to_reset)) { isolate({ smartUpdate(variable, defaults[[variable]], session) }) } showNotification( paste("Reloaded settings to default values"), type = "message" ) }) # Add new slide observeEvent(list(input$newSlide), ignoreInit = T, { # Reset all fields updateTextInput(session, "Samples", value = "") updateTextInput(session, "slide", value = "") updateTextInput(session, "Replicates", value = "") updateTextInput(session, "condition", value = "") # Reset grid values* for (row in 1:input$rows) { for (col in 1:input$columns) { updateTextInput(session, inputId = paste0("cell_", row, "_", col), value = "") } } # Message showNotification("New Slide added", type = "message") }) ##### Export acquired data to tsv ##### # observeEvent(input$downloadData, { # # open new temporary file # f <- tempfile(fileext = ".tsv") # # # write data_store() reactive value to emporary file # write.table(data_store(), f, row.names = FALSE, quote = T, sep="\t") # # # Encode in Base64 # encoded <- base64enc::base64encode(readBin(f, "raw", n = file.info(f)$size)) # # # JS per download client-side # #shinyjs::runjs(sprintf(" # #const a = document.createElement('a'); # #a.href = 'data:text/tab-separated-values;base64,%s'; # #a.download = 'MycorrhizeR_%s.tsv'; # #a.click(); # #", encoded, as.integer(Sys.time()))) # shinyjs::runjs(sprintf(" # const data = atob('%s'); // decodifica il base64 # const blob = new Blob([data], { type: 'text/tab-separated-values' }); # const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); # # const a = document.createElement('a'); # a.href = url; # a.download = 'MycorrhizeR_%s.tsv'; # document.body.appendChild(a); # a.click(); # document.body.removeChild(a); # URL.revokeObjectURL(url); // pulisce la memoria", # encoded, as.integer(Sys.time()))) # }) # Download handler (works in native shiny only) output$downloadData <- downloadHandler( filename = function() { paste("MycorrhizeR_", Sys.Date(), ".tsv") }, content = function(file) { write.table(data_store(), file, row.names = FALSE, quote = T, sep="\t") } ) #### Analyse data #### ##### Calculate Mycorrhizal parameters with Ramf package ##### # analyze data each time data_store is modified ramf_arb <- reactiveVal(NULL) ramf_ves <- reactiveVal(NULL) hypho_data <- reactiveVal(NULL) data_store_filtered<- reactiveVal(NULL) # filter data according to user's input observe({ req(data_store()) req(nrow(data_store()) > 0) # retain only selected samples according to user's input order_cats<-debounceInput(input$order_cats, 2000) if (!is.null(order_cats)) { data_store_filt <- data_store() %>% filter(Samples %in% order_cats) } else { data_store_filt<- data_store() } data_store_filtered(data_store_filt) } ) observe({ # proceed only if data is available req(data_store_filtered()) req(nrow(data_store_filtered()) > 0) # import data and pre-process (0 as 0A0) ramf_data<-data_store_filtered() %>% select(Samples, slide, Replicates, Scoring, everything()) %>% mutate(Replicates=as.character(Replicates), Scoring=str_replace_all(Scoring, c("^0$"="0A0"))) # extract arbuscules scoring ramf_data_arb<-ramf_data %>% #mutate(Scoring = str_remove(Scoring, "V.*")) mutate(Scoring = str_remove(Scoring, "(V.*)(H.*)?|(H.*)")) # extract vesicles scoring ramf_data_ves<-ramf_data %>% mutate(Scoring = if_else(str_detect(Scoring, "H.?"), str_remove(Scoring, "(H.*)"), Scoring)) %>% mutate(Scoring = if_else(str_detect(Scoring, "V[0-3]"), Scoring, paste0(Scoring, "V0"))) %>% mutate(Scoring = str_replace(str_remove(Scoring, "A[0-3]"),"V", "A")) # <script>const sectionChanged = new CustomEvent("quarto-sectionChanged", {
  detail: {},
  bubbles: true,
  cancelable: false,
  composed: false,
});

const layoutMarginEls = () => {
  // Find any conflicting margin elements and add margins to the
  // top to prevent overlap
  const marginChildren = window.document.querySelectorAll(
    ".column-margin.column-container > *, .margin-caption, .aside"
  );

  let lastBottom = 0;
  for (const marginChild of marginChildren) {
    if (marginChild.offsetParent !== null) {
      // clear the top margin so we recompute it
      marginChild.style.marginTop = null;
      const top = marginChild.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
      if (top < lastBottom) {
        const marginChildStyle = window.getComputedStyle(marginChild);
        const marginBottom = parseFloat(marginChildStyle["marginBottom"]);
        const margin = lastBottom - top + marginBottom;
        marginChild.style.marginTop = `${margin}px`;
      }
      const styles = window.getComputedStyle(marginChild);
      const marginTop = parseFloat(styles["marginTop"]);
      lastBottom = top + marginChild.getBoundingClientRect().height + marginTop;
    }
  }
};

window.document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function (_event) {
  // Recompute the position of margin elements anytime the body size changes
  if (window.ResizeObserver) {
    const resizeObserver = new window.ResizeObserver(
      throttle(() => {
        layoutMarginEls();
        if (
          window.document.body.getBoundingClientRect().width < 990 &&
          isReaderMode()
        ) {
          quartoToggleReader();
        }
      }, 50)
    );
    resizeObserver.observe(window.document.body);
  }

  const tocEl = window.document.querySelector('nav.toc-active[role="doc-toc"]');
  const sidebarEl = window.document.getElementById("quarto-sidebar");
  const leftTocEl = window.document.getElementById("quarto-sidebar-toc-left");
  const marginSidebarEl = window.document.getElementById(
    "quarto-margin-sidebar"
  );
  // function to determine whether the element has a previous sibling that is active
  const prevSiblingIsActiveLink = (el) => {
    const sibling = el.previousElementSibling;
    if (sibling && sibling.tagName === "A") {
      return sibling.classList.contains("active");
    } else {
      return false;
    }
  };

  // fire slideEnter for bootstrap tab activations (for htmlwidget resize behavior)
  function fireSlideEnter(e) {
    const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
    event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
    window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
  }
  const tabs = window.document.querySelectorAll('a[data-bs-toggle="tab"]');
  tabs.forEach((tab) => {
    tab.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", fireSlideEnter);
  });

  // fire slideEnter for tabby tab activations (for htmlwidget resize behavior)
  document.addEventListener("tabby", fireSlideEnter, false);

  // Track scrolling and mark TOC links as active
  // get table of contents and sidebar (bail if we don't have at least one)
  const tocLinks = tocEl
    ? [...tocEl.querySelectorAll("a[data-scroll-target]")]
    : [];
  const makeActive = (link) => tocLinks[link].classList.add("active");
  const removeActive = (link) => tocLinks[link].classList.remove("active");
  const removeAllActive = () =>
    [...Array(tocLinks.length).keys()].forEach((link) => removeActive(link));

  // activate the anchor for a section associated with this TOC entry
  tocLinks.forEach((link) => {
    link.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (link.href.indexOf("#") !== -1) {
        const anchor = link.href.split("#")[1];
        const heading = window.document.querySelector(
          `[data-anchor-id="${anchor}"]`
        );
        if (heading) {
          // Add the class
          heading.classList.add("reveal-anchorjs-link");

          // function to show the anchor
          const handleMouseout = () => {
            heading.classList.remove("reveal-anchorjs-link");
            heading.removeEventListener("mouseout", handleMouseout);
          };

          // add a function to clear the anchor when the user mouses out of it
          heading.addEventListener("mouseout", handleMouseout);
        }
      }
    });
  });

  const sections = tocLinks.map((link) => {
    const target = link.getAttribute("data-scroll-target");
    if (target.startsWith("#")) {
      return window.document.getElementById(decodeURI(`${target.slice(1)}`));
    } else {
      return window.document.querySelector(decodeURI(`${target}`));
    }
  });

  const sectionMargin = 200;
  let currentActive = 0;
  // track whether we've initialized state the first time
  let init = false;

  const updateActiveLink = () => {
    // The index from bottom to top (e.g. reversed list)
    let sectionIndex = -1;
    if (
      window.innerHeight + window.pageYOffset >=
      window.document.body.offsetHeight
    ) {
      // This is the no-scroll case where last section should be the active one
      sectionIndex = 0;
    } else {
      // This finds the last section visible on screen that should be made active
      sectionIndex = [...sections].reverse().findIndex((section) => {
        if (section) {
          return window.pageYOffset >= section.offsetTop - sectionMargin;
        } else {
          return false;
        }
      });
    }
    if (sectionIndex > -1) {
      const current = sections.length - sectionIndex - 1;
      if (current !== currentActive) {
        removeAllActive();
        currentActive = current;
        makeActive(current);
        if (init) {
          window.dispatchEvent(sectionChanged);
        }
        init = true;
      }
    }
  };

  const inHiddenRegion = (top, bottom, hiddenRegions) => {
    for (const region of hiddenRegions) {
      if (top <= region.bottom && bottom >= region.top) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  };

  const categorySelector = "header.quarto-title-block .quarto-category";
  const activateCategories = (href) => {
    // Find any categories
    // Surround them with a link pointing back to:
    // #category=Authoring
    try {
      const categoryEls = window.document.querySelectorAll(categorySelector);
      for (const categoryEl of categoryEls) {
        const categoryText = categoryEl.textContent;
        if (categoryText) {
          const link = `${href}#category=${encodeURIComponent(categoryText)}`;
          const linkEl = window.document.createElement("a");
          linkEl.setAttribute("href", link);
          for (const child of categoryEl.childNodes) {
            linkEl.append(child);
          }
          categoryEl.appendChild(linkEl);
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore errors
    }
  };
  function hasTitleCategories() {
    return window.document.querySelector(categorySelector) !== null;
  }

  function offsetRelativeUrl(url) {
    const offset = getMeta("quarto:offset");
    return offset ? offset + url : url;
  }

  function offsetAbsoluteUrl(url) {
    const offset = getMeta("quarto:offset");
    const baseUrl = new URL(offset, window.location);

    const projRelativeUrl = url.replace(baseUrl, "");
    if (projRelativeUrl.startsWith("/")) {
      return projRelativeUrl;
    } else {
      return "/" + projRelativeUrl;
    }
  }

  // read a meta tag value
  function getMeta(metaName) {
    const metas = window.document.getElementsByTagName("meta");
    for (let i = 0; i < metas.length; i++) {
      if (metas[i].getAttribute("name") === metaName) {
        return metas[i].getAttribute("content");
      }
    }
    return "";
  }

  async function findAndActivateCategories() {
    const currentPagePath = offsetAbsoluteUrl(window.location.href);
    const response = await fetch(offsetRelativeUrl("listings.json"));
    if (response.status == 200) {
      return response.json().then(function (listingPaths) {
        const listingHrefs = [];
        for (const listingPath of listingPaths) {
          const pathWithoutLeadingSlash = listingPath.listing.substring(1);
          for (const item of listingPath.items) {
            if (
              item === currentPagePath ||
              item === currentPagePath + "index.html"
            ) {
              // Resolve this path against the offset to be sure
              // we already are using the correct path to the listing
              // (this adjusts the listing urls to be rooted against
              // whatever root the page is actually running against)
              const relative = offsetRelativeUrl(pathWithoutLeadingSlash);
              const baseUrl = window.location;
              const resolvedPath = new URL(relative, baseUrl);
              listingHrefs.push(resolvedPath.pathname);
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        // Look up the tree for a nearby linting and use that if we find one
        const nearestListing = findNearestParentListing(
          offsetAbsoluteUrl(window.location.pathname),
          listingHrefs
        );
        if (nearestListing) {
          activateCategories(nearestListing);
        } else {
          // See if the referrer is a listing page for this item
          const referredRelativePath = offsetAbsoluteUrl(document.referrer);
          const referrerListing = listingHrefs.find((listingHref) => {
            const isListingReferrer =
              listingHref === referredRelativePath ||
              listingHref === referredRelativePath + "index.html";
            return isListingReferrer;
          });

          if (referrerListing) {
            // Try to use the referrer if possible
            activateCategories(referrerListing);
          } else if (listingHrefs.length > 0) {
            // Otherwise, just fall back to the first listing
            activateCategories(listingHrefs[0]);
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }
  if (hasTitleCategories()) {
    findAndActivateCategories();
  }

  const findNearestParentListing = (href, listingHrefs) => {
    if (!href || !listingHrefs) {
      return undefined;
    }
    // Look up the tree for a nearby linting and use that if we find one
    const relativeParts = href.substring(1).split("/");
    while (relativeParts.length > 0) {
      const path = relativeParts.join("/");
      for (const listingHref of listingHrefs) {
        if (listingHref.startsWith(path)) {
          return listingHref;
        }
      }
      relativeParts.pop();
    }

    return undefined;
  };

  const manageSidebarVisiblity = (el, placeholderDescriptor) => {
    let isVisible = true;
    let elRect;

    return (hiddenRegions) => {
      if (el === null) {
        return;
      }

      // Find the last element of the TOC
      const lastChildEl = el.lastElementChild;

      if (lastChildEl) {
        // Converts the sidebar to a menu
        const convertToMenu = () => {
          for (const child of el.children) {
            child.style.opacity = 0;
            child.style.overflow = "hidden";
            child.style.pointerEvents = "none";
          }

          nexttick(() => {
            const toggleContainer = window.document.createElement("div");
            toggleContainer.style.width = "100%";
            toggleContainer.classList.add("zindex-over-content");
            toggleContainer.classList.add("quarto-sidebar-toggle");
            toggleContainer.classList.add("headroom-target"); // Marks this to be managed by headeroom
            toggleContainer.id = placeholderDescriptor.id;
            toggleContainer.style.position = "fixed";

            const toggleIcon = window.document.createElement("i");
            toggleIcon.classList.add("quarto-sidebar-toggle-icon");
            toggleIcon.classList.add("bi");
            toggleIcon.classList.add("bi-caret-down-fill");

            const toggleTitle = window.document.createElement("div");
            const titleEl = window.document.body.querySelector(
              placeholderDescriptor.titleSelector
            );
            if (titleEl) {
              toggleTitle.append(
                titleEl.textContent || titleEl.innerText,
                toggleIcon
              );
            }
            toggleTitle.classList.add("zindex-over-content");
            toggleTitle.classList.add("quarto-sidebar-toggle-title");
            toggleContainer.append(toggleTitle);

            const toggleContents = window.document.createElement("div");
            toggleContents.classList = el.classList;
            toggleContents.classList.add("zindex-over-content");
            toggleContents.classList.add("quarto-sidebar-toggle-contents");
            for (const child of el.children) {
              if (child.id === "toc-title") {
                continue;
              }

              const clone = child.cloneNode(true);
              clone.style.opacity = 1;
              clone.style.pointerEvents = null;
              clone.style.display = null;
              toggleContents.append(clone);
            }
            toggleContents.style.height = "0px";
            const positionToggle = () => {
              // position the element (top left of parent, same width as parent)
              if (!elRect) {
                elRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
              }
              toggleContainer.style.left = `${elRect.left}px`;
              toggleContainer.style.top = `${elRect.top}px`;
              toggleContainer.style.width = `${elRect.width}px`;
            };
            positionToggle();

            toggleContainer.append(toggleContents);
            el.parentElement.prepend(toggleContainer);

            // Process clicks
            let tocShowing = false;
            // Allow the caller to control whether this is dismissed
            // when it is clicked (e.g. sidebar navigation supports
            // opening and closing the nav tree, so don't dismiss on click)
            const clickEl = placeholderDescriptor.dismissOnClick
              ? toggleContainer
              : toggleTitle;

            const closeToggle = () => {
              if (tocShowing) {
                toggleContainer.classList.remove("expanded");
                toggleContents.style.height = "0px";
                tocShowing = false;
              }
            };

            // Get rid of any expanded toggle if the user scrolls
            window.document.addEventListener(
              "scroll",
              throttle(() => {
                closeToggle();
              }, 50)
            );

            // Handle positioning of the toggle
            window.addEventListener(
              "resize",
              throttle(() => {
                elRect = undefined;
                positionToggle();
              }, 50)
            );

            window.addEventListener("quarto-hrChanged", () => {
              elRect = undefined;
            });

            // Process the click
            clickEl.onclick = () => {
              if (!tocShowing) {
                toggleContainer.classList.add("expanded");
                toggleContents.style.height = null;
                tocShowing = true;
              } else {
                closeToggle();
              }
            };
          });
        };

        // Converts a sidebar from a menu back to a sidebar
        const convertToSidebar = () => {
          for (const child of el.children) {
            child.style.opacity = 1;
            child.style.overflow = null;
            child.style.pointerEvents = null;
          }

          const placeholderEl = window.document.getElementById(
            placeholderDescriptor.id
          );
          if (placeholderEl) {
            placeholderEl.remove();
          }

          el.classList.remove("rollup");
        };

        if (isReaderMode()) {
          convertToMenu();
          isVisible = false;
        } else {
          // Find the top and bottom o the element that is being managed
          const elTop = el.offsetTop;
          const elBottom =
            elTop + lastChildEl.offsetTop + lastChildEl.offsetHeight;

          if (!isVisible) {
            // If the element is current not visible reveal if there are
            // no conflicts with overlay regions
            if (!inHiddenRegion(elTop, elBottom, hiddenRegions)) {
              convertToSidebar();
              isVisible = true;
            }
          } else {
            // If the element is visible, hide it if it conflicts with overlay regions
            // and insert a placeholder toggle (or if we're in reader mode)
            if (inHiddenRegion(elTop, elBottom, hiddenRegions)) {
              convertToMenu();
              isVisible = false;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };
  };

  const tabEls = document.querySelectorAll('a[data-bs-toggle="tab"]');
  for (const tabEl of tabEls) {
    const id = tabEl.getAttribute("data-bs-target");
    if (id) {
      const columnEl = document.querySelector(
        `${id} .column-margin, .tabset-margin-content`
      );
      if (columnEl)
        tabEl.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", function (event) {
          const el = event.srcElement;
          if (el) {
            const visibleCls = `${el.id}-margin-content`;
            // walk up until we find a parent tabset
            let panelTabsetEl = el.parentElement;
            while (panelTabsetEl) {
              if (panelTabsetEl.classList.contains("panel-tabset")) {
                break;
              }
              panelTabsetEl = panelTabsetEl.parentElement;
            }

            if (panelTabsetEl) {
              const prevSib = panelTabsetEl.previousElementSibling;
              if (
                prevSib &&
                prevSib.classList.contains("tabset-margin-container")
              ) {
                const childNodes = prevSib.querySelectorAll(
                  ".tabset-margin-content"
                );
                for (const childEl of childNodes) {
                  if (childEl.classList.contains(visibleCls)) {
                    childEl.classList.remove("collapse");
                  } else {
                    childEl.classList.add("collapse");
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

          layoutMarginEls();
        });
    }
  }

  // Manage the visibility of the toc and the sidebar
  const marginScrollVisibility = manageSidebarVisiblity(marginSidebarEl, {
    id: "quarto-toc-toggle",
    titleSelector: "#toc-title",
    dismissOnClick: true,
  });
  const sidebarScrollVisiblity = manageSidebarVisiblity(sidebarEl, {
    id: "quarto-sidebarnav-toggle",
    titleSelector: ".title",
    dismissOnClick: false,
  });
  let tocLeftScrollVisibility;
  if (leftTocEl) {
    tocLeftScrollVisibility = manageSidebarVisiblity(leftTocEl, {
      id: "quarto-lefttoc-toggle",
      titleSelector: "#toc-title",
      dismissOnClick: true,
    });
  }

  // Find the first element that uses formatting in special columns
  const conflictingEls = window.document.body.querySelectorAll(
    '[class^="column-"], [class*=" column-"], aside, [class*="margin-caption"], [class*=" margin-caption"], [class*="margin-ref"], [class*=" margin-ref"]'
  );

  // Filter all the possibly conflicting elements into ones
  // the do conflict on the left or ride side
  const arrConflictingEls = Array.from(conflictingEls);
  const leftSideConflictEls = arrConflictingEls.filter((el) => {
    if (el.tagName === "ASIDE") {
      return false;
    }
    return Array.from(el.classList).find((className) => {
      return (
        className !== "column-body" &&
        className.startsWith("column-") &&
        !className.endsWith("right") &&
        !className.endsWith("container") &&
        className !== "column-margin"
      );
    });
  });
  const rightSideConflictEls = arrConflictingEls.filter((el) => {
    if (el.tagName === "ASIDE") {
      return true;
    }

    const hasMarginCaption = Array.from(el.classList).find((className) => {
      return className == "margin-caption";
    });
    if (hasMarginCaption) {
      return true;
    }

    return Array.from(el.classList).find((className) => {
      return (
        className !== "column-body" &&
        !className.endsWith("container") &&
        className.startsWith("column-") &&
        !className.endsWith("left")
      );
    });
  });

  const kOverlapPaddingSize = 10;
  function toRegions(els) {
    return els.map((el) => {
      const boundRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top =
        boundRect.top +
        document.documentElement.scrollTop -
        kOverlapPaddingSize;
      return {
        top,
        bottom: top + el.scrollHeight + 2 * kOverlapPaddingSize,
      };
    });
  }

  let hasObserved = false;
  const visibleItemObserver = (els) => {
    let visibleElements = [...els];
    const intersectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries, _observer) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            if (visibleElements.indexOf(entry.target) === -1) {
              visibleElements.push(entry.target);
            }
          } else {
            visibleElements = visibleElements.filter((visibleEntry) => {
              return visibleEntry !== entry;
            });
          }
        });

        if (!hasObserved) {
          hideOverlappedSidebars();
        }
        hasObserved = true;
      },
      {}
    );
    els.forEach((el) => {
      intersectionObserver.observe(el);
    });

    return {
      getVisibleEntries: () => {
        return visibleElements;
      },
    };
  };

  const rightElementObserver = visibleItemObserver(rightSideConflictEls);
  const leftElementObserver = visibleItemObserver(leftSideConflictEls);

  const hideOverlappedSidebars = () => {
    marginScrollVisibility(toRegions(rightElementObserver.getVisibleEntries()));
    sidebarScrollVisiblity(toRegions(leftElementObserver.getVisibleEntries()));
    if (tocLeftScrollVisibility) {
      tocLeftScrollVisibility(
        toRegions(leftElementObserver.getVisibleEntries())
      );
    }
  };

  window.quartoToggleReader = () => {
    // Applies a slow class (or removes it)
    // to update the transition speed
    const slowTransition = (slow) => {
      const manageTransition = (id, slow) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) {
          if (slow) {
            el.classList.add("slow");
          } else {
            el.classList.remove("slow");
          }
        }
      };

      manageTransition("TOC", slow);
      manageTransition("quarto-sidebar", slow);
    };
    const readerMode = !isReaderMode();
    setReaderModeValue(readerMode);

    // If we're entering reader mode, slow the transition
    if (readerMode) {
      slowTransition(readerMode);
    }
    highlightReaderToggle(readerMode);
    hideOverlappedSidebars();

    // If we're exiting reader mode, restore the non-slow transition
    if (!readerMode) {
      slowTransition(!readerMode);
    }
  };

  const highlightReaderToggle = (readerMode) => {
    const els = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-reader-toggle");
    if (els) {
      els.forEach((el) => {
        if (readerMode) {
          el.classList.add("reader");
        } else {
          el.classList.remove("reader");
        }
      });
    }
  };

  const setReaderModeValue = (val) => {
    if (window.location.protocol !== "file:") {
      window.localStorage.setItem("quarto-reader-mode", val);
    } else {
      localReaderMode = val;
    }
  };

  const isReaderMode = () => {
    if (window.location.protocol !== "file:") {
      return window.localStorage.getItem("quarto-reader-mode") === "true";
    } else {
      return localReaderMode;
    }
  };
  let localReaderMode = null;

  const tocOpenDepthStr = tocEl?.getAttribute("data-toc-expanded");
  const tocOpenDepth = tocOpenDepthStr ? Number(tocOpenDepthStr) : 1;

  // Walk the TOC and collapse/expand nodes
  // Nodes are expanded if:
  // - they are top level
  // - they have children that are 'active' links
  // - they are directly below an link that is 'active'
  const walk = (el, depth) => {
    // Tick depth when we enter a UL
    if (el.tagName === "UL") {
      depth = depth + 1;
    }

    // It this is active link
    let isActiveNode = false;
    if (el.tagName === "A" && el.classList.contains("active")) {
      isActiveNode = true;
    }

    // See if there is an active child to this element
    let hasActiveChild = false;
    for (child of el.children) {
      hasActiveChild = walk(child, depth) || hasActiveChild;
    }

    // Process the collapse state if this is an UL
    if (el.tagName === "UL") {
      if (tocOpenDepth === -1 && depth > 1) {
        // toc-expand: false
        el.classList.add("collapse");
      } else if (
        depth <= tocOpenDepth ||
        hasActiveChild ||
        prevSiblingIsActiveLink(el)
      ) {
        el.classList.remove("collapse");
      } else {
        el.classList.add("collapse");
      }

      // untick depth when we leave a UL
      depth = depth - 1;
    }
    return hasActiveChild || isActiveNode;
  };

  // walk the TOC and expand / collapse any items that should be shown
  if (tocEl) {
    updateActiveLink();
    walk(tocEl, 0);
  }

  // Throttle the scroll event and walk peridiocally
  window.document.addEventListener(
    "scroll",
    throttle(() => {
      if (tocEl) {
        updateActiveLink();
        walk(tocEl, 0);
      }
      if (!isReaderMode()) {
        hideOverlappedSidebars();
      }
    }, 5)
  );
  window.addEventListener(
    "resize",
    throttle(() => {
      if (tocEl) {
        updateActiveLink();
        walk(tocEl, 0);
      }
      if (!isReaderMode()) {
        hideOverlappedSidebars();
      }
    }, 10)
  );
  hideOverlappedSidebars();
  highlightReaderToggle(isReaderMode());
});

// grouped tabsets
window.addEventListener("pageshow", (_event) => {
  function getTabSettings() {
    const data = localStorage.getItem("quarto-persistent-tabsets-data");
    if (!data) {
      localStorage.setItem("quarto-persistent-tabsets-data", "{}");
      return {};
    }
    if (data) {
      return JSON.parse(data);
    }
  }

<section id="credits-and-implementation-details" class="level4">
<h4 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="credits-and-implementation-details">Credits and Implementation details</h4>
<p>This app was written with R programming language and Shiny.</p>
<p>Data visualization was partly inspired by <a href="https://huygens.science.uva.nl/PlotsOfData/" target="_blank">PlotsOfData</a> <span class="citation" data-cites="postma_plotsofdataweb_2019">(<a href="#ref-postma_plotsofdataweb_2019" role="doc-biblioref">Postma and Goedhart 2019</a>)</span></p>
<p>MycorrhizeR logo is written with <a href="https://github.com/NaN-xyz/Rubik-Filtered" target="_blank"><em>Rubik Dirt</em></a> font, licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.</p>
<section id="r-packages-used" class="level5">
<h5 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="r-packages-used">R packages used</h5>
<ul>
<li><strong>Web app</strong>:
<ul>
<li><a href="https://shiny.posit.co/" target="_blank">shiny</a></li>
<li><a href="https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/" target="_blank">shinylive</a> <span class="citation" data-cites="shinylive">(<a href="#ref-shinylive" role="doc-biblioref">Schloerke et al. 2025</a>)</span></li>
<li><a href="https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/" target="_blank">webr</a> <span class="citation" data-cites="webr">(<a href="#ref-webr" role="doc-biblioref">Stagg and Henry 2024</a>)</span></li>
<li><a href="https://r-wasm.github.io/rwasm/" target="_blank">rwasm</a> <span class="citation" data-cites="rwasm">(<a href="#ref-rwasm" role="doc-biblioref">Stagg 2024</a>)</span></li>
<li><a href="https://rstudio.github.io/DT/" target="_blank">DT</a></li>
<li><a href="https://rstudio.github.io/bslib/" target="_blank">bslib</a></li>
<li><a href="https://deanattali.com/shinyjs/" target="_blank">shinyjs</a></li>
</ul></li>
<li><strong>Data wrangling</strong>:
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.tidyverse.org/" target="_blank">tidyverse</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/mchiapello/Ramf" target="_blank">Ramf</a> <span class="citation" data-cites="chiapello_ramf_2019">(<a href="#ref-chiapello_ramf_2019" role="doc-biblioref">Chiapello, Das, and Gutjahr 2019</a>)</span></li>
</ul></li>
<li><strong>Visualization</strong>:
<ul>
<li><a href="https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/" target="_blank">ggplot2</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/eclarke/ggbeeswarm" target="_blank">ggbeeswarm</a></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<p>The app is build with Shinylive <span class="citation" data-cites="shinylive">(<a href="#ref-shinylive" role="doc-biblioref">Schloerke et al. 2025</a>)</span> to execute R code into user’s browser through WebAssembly (Wasm) using webR package <span class="citation" data-cites="webr">(<a href="#ref-webr" role="doc-biblioref">Stagg and Henry 2024</a>)</span>.</p>
<p><em>Shinylive version 0.3.0 (assets version 0.9.1)</em></p>
<p>Data uploaded in MycorrhizeR are not stored or shared through the web but remains in your browser’s on your PC.</p>
<p>Mycorrizal parameteres are calculated using Ramf package <span class="citation" data-cites="chiapello_ramf_2019">(<a href="#ref-chiapello_ramf_2019" role="doc-biblioref">Chiapello, Das, and Gutjahr 2019</a>)</span>.</p>
<p>Ramf and BiocStyle R packages have been build using rwasm <span class="citation" data-cites="rwasm">(<a href="#ref-rwasm" role="doc-biblioref">Stagg 2024</a>)</span> and made available through webR through a dedicated github repository at <a href="https://github.com/mchialva/my-rwasm-repo" target="_blank">mchialva/my-rwasm-repo</a></p>
<p>The example dataset is from <span class="citation" data-cites="chialva2024">Chialva et al. (<a href="#ref-chialva2024" role="doc-biblioref">2024</a>)</span>.</p>

content: local function ensureLatexDeps() quarto.doc.use_latex_package("fontawesome5") end local function ensureHtmlDeps() quarto.doc.add_html_dependency({ name = 'fontawesome6', version = '1.2.0', stylesheets = {'assets/css/all.min.css', 'assets/css/latex-fontsize.css'} }) end local function isEmpty(s) return s == nil or s == '' end local function isValidSize(size) local validSizes = { "tiny", "scriptsize", "footnotesize", "small", "normalsize", "large", "Large", "LARGE", "huge", "Huge" } for _, v in ipairs(validSizes) do if v == size then return size end end return "" end return { ["fa"] = function(args, kwargs) local group = "solid" local icon = pandoc.utils.stringify(args[1]) if #args > 1 then group = icon icon = pandoc.utils.stringify(args[2]) end local title = pandoc.utils.stringify(kwargs["title"]) if not isEmpty(title) then title = " title=\"" .. title .. "\"" end local label = pandoc.utils.stringify(kwargs["label"]) if isEmpty(label) then label = " aria-label=\"" .. icon .. "\"" else label = " aria-label=\"" .. label .. "\"" end local size = pandoc.utils.stringify(kwargs["size"]) -- detect html (excluding epub which won't handle fa) if quarto.doc.is_format("html:js") then ensureHtmlDeps() if not isEmpty(size) then size = " fa-" .. size end return pandoc.RawInline( 'html', "" ) -- detect pdf / beamer / latex / etc elseif quarto.doc.is_format("pdf") then ensureLatexDeps() if isEmpty(isValidSize(size)) then return pandoc.RawInline('tex', "\\faIcon{" .. icon .. "}") else return pandoc.RawInline('tex', "{\\" .. size .. "\\faIcon{" .. icon .. "}}") end else return pandoc.Null() end end }

	title = {Ramf: {An} {Open}-{Source} {R} {Package} for {Statistical} {Analysis} and {Display} of {Quantitative} {Root} {Colonization} by {Arbuscular} {Mycorrhiza} {Fungi}},
	volume = {10},

	shorttitle = {Ramf},
	url = {https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/plant-science/articles/10.3389/fpls.2019.01184/full},
	doi = {10.3389/fpls.2019.01184},
	abstract = {{\textless}p{\textgreater}Data analysis and graphical representation form an essential part of scientific research dissemination. The life-science community is moving towards a more transparent presentation of single data points or data distributions and away from mean values displayed as bar charts. To facilitate transparent data display to the mycorrhiza community, we present “Ramf” an open-source R package for statistical analysis and preparation of a variety of publication-ready plots, custom-made for analyzing and displaying quantitative root colonization by arbuscular mycorrhiza fungi or any kind of data to be displayed in the same format. Ramf replaces the scripting needed for data analysis and can be readily used by researchers not acquainted with R. In addition, the package is open to improvements by the community. Ramf is available at {\textless}uri xlink:href="https://github.com/mchiapello/Ramf" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"{\textgreater}https://github.com/mchiapello/Ramf{\textless}/uri{\textgreater}.{\textless}/p{\textgreater}},

}

	title = {{PlotsOfData}—{A} web app for visualizing data together with their summaries},
	volume = {17},
	issn = {1545-7885},
	url = {https://journals.plos.org/plosbiology/article?id=10.1371/journal.pbio.3000202},
	doi = {10.1371/journal.pbio.3000202},
	abstract = {Reporting of the actual data in graphs and plots increases transparency and enables independent evaluation. On the other hand, data summaries are often used in graphs because they aid interpretation. To democratize state-of-the-art data visualization of raw data with a selection of statistical summaries, a freely available, open-source web app was written using R/shiny that uses the ggplot2 package for generating plots. Users can to choose how to display the data and which of the data summaries to add. In addition, the 95\% confidence intervals (95CIs) can be added for visual inferences. By adjusting the visibility of the layers, the visualization of the raw data and their summaries can be tuned for optimal presentation and interpretation. The app is dubbed PlotsOfData and is available at https://huygens.science.uva.nl/PlotsOfData/.},

content: local function ensureLatexDeps() quarto.doc.use_latex_package("fontawesome5") end local function ensureHtmlDeps() quarto.doc.add_html_dependency({ name = 'fontawesome6', version = '1.2.0', stylesheets = {'assets/css/all.min.css', 'assets/css/latex-fontsize.css'} }) end local function isEmpty(s) return s == nil or s == '' end local function isValidSize(size) local validSizes = { "tiny", "scriptsize", "footnotesize", "small", "normalsize", "large", "Large", "LARGE", "huge", "Huge" } for _, v in ipairs(validSizes) do if v == size then return size end end return "" end return { ["fa"] = function(args, kwargs) local group = "solid" local icon = pandoc.utils.stringify(args[1]) if #args > 1 then group = icon icon = pandoc.utils.stringify(args[2]) end local title = pandoc.utils.stringify(kwargs["title"]) if not isEmpty(title) then title = " title=\"" .. title .. "\"" end local label = pandoc.utils.stringify(kwargs["label"]) if isEmpty(label) then label = " aria-label=\"" .. icon .. "\"" else label = " aria-label=\"" .. label .. "\"" end local size = pandoc.utils.stringify(kwargs["size"]) -- detect html (excluding epub which won't handle fa) if quarto.doc.is_format("html:js") then ensureHtmlDeps() if not isEmpty(size) then size = " fa-" .. size end return pandoc.RawInline( 'html', "" ) -- detect pdf / beamer / latex / etc elseif quarto.doc.is_format("pdf") then ensureLatexDeps() if isEmpty(isValidSize(size)) then return pandoc.RawInline('tex', "\\faIcon{" .. icon .. "}") else return pandoc.RawInline('tex', "{\\" .. size .. "\\faIcon{" .. icon .. "}}") end else return pandoc.Null() end end }
